Title: One Under 30: Young Creative Spotlight - Linxuan Lyu | Branding in Asia
# One Under 30: Young Creative Spotlight – Linxuan Lyu. **A**s part of an ongoing series highlighting young talent in the industry, *Branding in Asia* brings you “One Under 30: Young Creative Spotlight”, a regular feature that focuses on up-and-coming talent in the ad world. This week we feature Linxuan Lyu, a 30-year-old Senior Designer at Superunion in Shanghai. When asked about his creative inspirations, Lyu said that even the most “mundane” things in life offer inspiration. “Just walking along the street, sounds, colors, strangers passing you by – even a falling leaf can inspire.”. I started my career as a designer right out of grad school for an advertising company. I was so excited to come up with new ideas and make them happen for different clients whilst working with an eclectic team of creative talents. I learned so much from those early days as a designer – every project and challenge pushed me to expand my skillset and helped me progress to where I am today. ### From what person, place, or thing have you drawn your greatest creative inspiration? I would say there isn’t a specific person or thing that has inspired me – rather life in general does. Just walking along the street, sounds, colors, strangers passing you by – even a falling leaf can inspire. Working with a director/mentor who listens and embraces all possible solutions and encourages you to make it happen, is also a very rewarding aspect of my job. Title: Ethan Linxuan Zhang - Charleston International Music Competition
# Ethan Linxuan Zhang. Ethan began studying viola in the fourth grade and has since cultivated a profound commitment to music. He currently performs with the Maryland Classic Youth Orchestra (MCYO) and was selected for the Maryland All-State Junior Orchestra this year, an honor that reflects both his dedication and artistic achievement. In addition to his musical pursuits, Ethan is actively engaged in robotics and skiing, disciplines that highlight his intellectual curiosity, problem-solving skills, and perseverance. Across all endeavors, Ethan demonstrates a passion for excellence and a readiness to embrace new challenges.
